title: Family Roles
description: Plain-text guide to assigning emergency responsibilities to adults, teens, children, and toddlers in five steps: identify tasks, match skills, designate backups, document, and practice. Includes role card templates and advice for single-parent, multigenerational, blended, and special-needs families.
shortDescription: Assign emergency jobs by age, with backups and printable role cards
author: OfflineOwl Contributors
